observations: Photo 0 shows four small black portable external hard drives laid on a wooden table.
Two drives appear to have a faint logo resembling an 'S' shape (possibly Seagate) but it is not legible enough to confirm.
No model numbers, capacity labels, or serial stickers are readable in the image.
No cables, boxes, or power adapters are visible.
Watermark 'posted on bola.ng' overlays the image; no other identifying text is visible.

claims.claim: There are 48 PS4 PKG games inside these four 500GB external hard drives (2TB total).
claims.evidence: No screenshot of file listings, folder contents, or a PS4 console showing the games running is provided; capacity and content cannot be confirmed from a photo of the closed drive casings.
No label, sticker, or device properties screen showing capacity is visible in photo 0.

risks.risk: Drives may not power on or may have read/write errors.
risks.proof: A video of each drive being plugged into a PC/PS4 showing it mounts and is accessible.

risks.risk: Stated capacity (500GB each) may be inflated or mismatched.
risks.proof: Screenshot of 'My Computer'/disk properties showing true capacity for each drive.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the lowest plausible capacity for this drive size/form factor

risks.risk: The 48 PS4 PKG games may be incomplete, corrupted, or non-bootable.
risks.proof: A short clip of a PS4 browsing the game list and launching at least one title from each drive.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if no working games are included, i.e. as bare storage drives only

risks.risk: Physical condition (drop damage, worn USB port, cracked casing) not visible from this angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each drive's top, bottom, and USB port.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavy cosmetic wear / risk of port damage

risks.risk: Brand/model unknown, which affects resale value and warranty status.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the label/sticker on each drive showing brand and model.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/unbranded external HDD

proof_requests: Video of each of the four drives connected to a PC or PS4 showing the folder/game list and a game actually launching.
Close-up photos of each drive's label/sticker showing brand, model, and capacity.
Screenshot of disk properties confirming real formatted capacity for each drive.
Close-up photos of each drive's casing and USB port for cosmetic/functional condition.
response.reason: The item can be identified by type as a set of four external hard drives, but all seller claims about capacity, brand, and the 48 preloaded PS4 games are unverifiable from the single photo, so it must be priced at the worst case as bare, unverified-working generic drives until proof is supplied.
